title: Apply from the public roles board after sign-in
summary: Anyone can browse open roles without signing in. Choosing to apply now takes visitors through sign-in or registration and back to the application form.
changes: Apply links on a role page send signed-out visitors to Public Login or Register, then back to that role's application form.
New accounts return to the form once account setup is finished.
Signed-in visitors go straight to the form.
version_rationale: Patch: adds a redirect step to the existing public roles board, with no data change.
validation: New feature test for the sign-in and registration round trips, signed-in shortcut and closed roles.
Recruitment, account lifecycle, onboarding and translation tests.
known_limitations: If the email verification link is opened in a different browser, new accounts land on the dashboard instead of the form.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. No data changes.
provenance: Milestone v0.47.4 Beta, issue #465 under epic #463, pull request #595.
